caveat: Component-only measurement of one fixed ordered input set and one selected FP32 chunk; not 32-card end-to-end training throughput or optimizer-step speedup. Each timed reduce_chunk is synchronous and includes source manifest checks, selected-chunk reads/hash/finite checks, ordered FP32 weighted accumulation and output writes/fsync. Process startup, input snapshot checks and output byte comparison are outside timing. A fresh CPU process owns each trial; process CPU time includes its prefetch threads. RSS is process memory, not NPU memory. No cache eviction is attempted; filesystem/page caches, host load and trial order can affect results. Logical bytes do not measure physical storage or network traffic. Source manifests and file identities are checked before/after each trial, and selected source chunks are hashed during reduction; unselected payload bytes are not audited. Frozen source code is not executed or revalidated as a new training run.
